films.title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
films.description: Miyazaki borrowed the Homeric princess's name for his wind-riding heroine — Nausicaa reborn as ecological saviour in a poisoned future.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: Konchalovsky's miniseries keeps the Phaeacian laundry shore — Nausicaa as the civilised welcome that sends Odysseus home.

popCulture.title: Nausicaa
popCulture.description: Nausicaa remains the type of the generous princess at the water's edge — the Odyssey's most graceful host, forever almost a bride.
